import numpy as np

# Get cube poses and extents
red_pos, _, red_extent = get_object_pose("red cube", return_bbox_extent=True)
green_pos, _, green_extent = get_object_pose("green cube", return_bbox_extent=True)

# Grasp the red cube with an approach from above
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = sample_grasp_pose("red cube")
open_gripper()
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.1)
close_gripper()

# Lift the red cube straight up to clear obstacles
lift_pos = grasp_pos.copy()
lift_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# Compute placement: the red cube's center should sit on top of the green cube.
# Red cube bottom at green top => red center z = green_center_z + green_h/2 + red_h/2
# The gripper offset relative to the red cube center is (grasp_pos - red_pos); keep it.
grasp_offset = grasp_pos - red_pos
target_red_center = np.array([
    green_pos[0],
    green_pos[1],
    green_pos[2] + green_extent[2] / 2.0 + red_extent[2] / 2.0
])
place_pos = target_red_center + grasp_offset

# Move above the green cube, then descend gently to the placement height
goto_pose(place_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.1)

# Release the cube only once it is resting on the green cube
open_gripper()

# Retreat upward
retreat_pos = place_pos.copy()
retreat_pos[2] += 0.1
goto_pose(retreat_pos, grasp_quat)
